title: feat(platform-objects,service-messaging): Setup lists show their own empty state; API Keys gains Create Key
body:
Fixes #23852

Clause-②: no

Setup's Invitations, API Keys, OAuth Applications and the three notification lists now draw their own empty state instead of the console's fallbacks, and API Keys gains a **Create Key** button that mints through the existing `POST /api/v1/keys` route. Metadata, bundles and tests only; no field, index, permission or route changes.

## What changes

**1. Every list view declares its own `emptyState` (title + one sentence).**

| object | view | title |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sys_invitation` | `pending` (Setup opens this one) | No pending invitations |
| | `accepted` | No accepted invitations |
| | `expired` | No expired or canceled invitations |
| | `all_invitations` | No invitations yet |
| `sys_api_key` | `all_keys` (Setup) | No API keys yet |
| | `mine` (Account app) | You have no API keys yet |
| | `active` | No active API keys |
| | `revoked` | No revoked keys |
| `sys_oauth_application` | `all_apps` (Setup) | No OAuth applications yet |
| | `mine` (Account app) | You have no OAuth applications yet |
| | `active` | No active OAuth applications |
| | `disabled_apps` | No disabled OAuth applications |
| `sys_notification_preference` | `all` (new) | No preferences yet |
| `sys_notification_subscription` | `all` (new) | No subscriptions yet |
| `sys_notification_template` | `all` (new) | No templates yet |

The three identity objects are `managedBy: 'better-auth'`, so with no declaration objectui drew the identity fallback ("created by the authentication provider … not added by hand here"), which is false for all three.

**The three notification objects had no list view at all** (a PM mechanism assumption this falsifies: the claim says "the list views of" them, and there were none). The only per-list empty copy the spec carries is a list view's `emptyState`, so each now ships one view, `all`, declared for that copy alone. It has `columns: []`, which is the spec's own "declares no projection, left to the renderer" form, so objectui keeps deriving the same columns from `highlightFields` (org attribution column included), and it has no `filter`, `sort` or `pagination`. The view id `all` is the id objectui's synthesized tab already had. The one visible side effect is the tab label: "All" (translated) instead of the console's "All records".

**2. API Keys: `create_api_key` ("Create Key"), a primary `list_toolbar` action.** It calls `POST /api/v1/keys` with a required `name` (field-backed on `sys_api_key.name`) and shows the raw key in a `resultDialog` (`path: 'key'`, `format: 'secret'`). It declares no `successMessage`, because the dialog suppresses the toast. It appears on every `sys_api_key` list, Setup's `all_keys` and the Account app's `mine`. The route pins the key to the caller (`user_id` and the active organization are never read from the body), so an admin on Setup mints their own key exactly as a user does on My Keys. The param dialog's `description` says this.

**3. Copy in every locale.** The `en` bundles are regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, and the `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` leaves are hand-written. Rerunning `--write` after the translation dropped every provenance row the fill had added, so the `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` files have no net change.

## Item 2's route reading (the card's condition)

The card asks the claimant to confirm the route and, if a new door is needed, to treat that half as its own question. **No new door is needed:**

- The route is `POST /api/v1/keys`: `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts` (`createKeysDomains` / `handleKeysRequest`), mounted at `server.post(prefix + '/keys')` in `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`, route-ledger row `POST /keys` (`disposition: 'sdk'`, `client: 'keys.create'`). It is the only mint path. It whitelists `name` and an optional `expires_at`, answers `201 { success, data: { id, name, prefix, key, … } }` with the raw key once, and stores only the hash. It does not depend on `sys_api_key`'s `create` affordance, which stays off. The PM's grep for `createApiKey` / `api-keys` missed it because the names are `keys` / `createKeysDomains`.
- Its console callers today (objectui `origin/main` `a5bb7ac`) are the `mcp:connect-agent` widget (`packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`) and the developer Integrations page (`apps/console/src/pages/developer/AgentConnectSection.tsx`). The Account app's API Keys entry (`nav_account_api_keys` → `sys_api_key` view `mine`) rendered the same object list as Setup, with no create entry. This action is now that entry on both pages.
- An object action reaches it unchanged. objectui's `apiHandler` (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`) POSTs an absolute `type: 'api'` target with the session cookie, unwraps `{ success, data }`, and resolves `resultDialog` paths against `data`. That is the mechanism `sys_oauth_application.create_oauth_application` already uses for its one-shot client secret.

## Tests (metadata level)

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/setup-list-empty-states.test.ts` (new). For the three identity objects, the population is each object's declared views. It checks that every view declares a non-empty title and message, that no two views of one object share a title (a filtered view names itself), and that Pending's title is "No pending invitations" (the card's acceptance names it). It checks that the `en` bundle carries each view's copy as declared and that `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` carry it. For Create Key, it checks the primary `list_toolbar` placement, `POST /api/v1/keys`, the `key` reveal as `secret`, params limited to what the route reads and backed by real fields, `create` still absent from `apiMethods`, and that the two empty states naming Create Key carry the action's label.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/two-factor-one-shot-reveal.test.ts`: the class guard's `ONE_SHOT_ROUTES` table gains `/api/v1/keys` → `['key']`. Every action on that route is now held to a covering `resultDialog` and no `successMessage`, the same as the 2FA routes. This closes the class rather than adding a single-point pin.
- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/setup-list-empty-states.test.ts` (new): every view of the three notification objects declares the copy, the `all` view declares no projection, filter, sort or page size, and all four bundles carry the label and copy.

Run on `8944600e5` (the PR head, after merging `origin/main`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 72 files / 1128 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test`: 52 files / 584 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects --filter @objectstack/service-messaging typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --listFiles` confirms all three test files are in a type-check program.

Ablation, one per new pin, each via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor hit once, the blob changed, and the restore was proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`). The subjects are imported from `src`, so no build or `dist` leg applies:

1. Deleting Pending's `title` made 3 tests red: every-view-declares, the Pending pin and the en-bundle equality.
2. Deleting the `{ path: 'key' … }` reveal field made 2 tests red: the one-shot class guard ("does not reveal 'key'") and the masked-reveal pin.
3. Changing `sys_notification_template`'s `columns: []` to `['topic', 'channel']` made the no-projection pin red.

## Gates

The derived list is `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `8944600e5`. The run is reconciled with `--ran` (exit codes recorded): **65 derived, 64 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.**

- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because it reads every package's `dist/` and this worktree built only the i18n closure. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- `pnpm check:i18n` and `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` exit 0. The coverage log reads "14 config(s), 621 baselined untranslated string(s), none new".
- The artifact-roster families whose roster sits under one of these paths ran locally with exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `pnpm check:authz-resolver`, `pnpm check:error-code-casing` and `pnpm check:filter-alias-parity`.
- Families CI runs (the fast set, type-check lanes, test-repo) are left to this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- **Subscriptions copy departs from the original card on purpose.** The card proposed "Subscribe a role, team or user to a topic". The object's own header records that nothing reads subscription rows at runtime (no recipient expansion is wired), so the empty state says what a row records, "follows a notification topic", and promises no delivery.
- **`sys_oauth_application`'s `active` view filters `disabled == false`.** The object's comments say better-auth writes `disabled` only when it is set. If such rows hold NULL, the `equals false` filter would leave never-toggled applications out of Active. This is not measured here and is an inference from the comment alone. The Active empty state is worded so it stays true either way ("stays active until it is disabled").
- `sys_api_key`'s header docblock says the raw token is returned "via the auth plugin API". The mint path is the runtime `keys` domain. This is comment drift and was left untouched.
- `service-messaging`'s `ja-JP` / `es-ES` bundles are otherwise English for these three objects (pre-existing echoes). The new empty-state leaves are translated, so those pages mix languages until the rest is translated.
- `examples` and `packages/qa/dogfood` were not run locally. The `sys_api_key` dogfood pins (`api-key-revoke-lifecycle`, `api-key-owner-revoke`) assert the revoke and restore actions by name, and those actions are unchanged.
